 * Please note that only one early career application per candidate. 
 About bp 
 bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition.

 Taking on the role of Process Engineering Intern means designing projects and supervising plant development to ensure the reliability of our upstream productions .  Deliver innovative solutions that take our business forward.  
 Support the design production and utilize your knowledge to optimize their operation.

description:

 Job Description 
 Ambarella has some exciting internship opportunities for self-motivated and creative students near completing of their master's degree. We are looking for talented software programmers who possess a strong interest in computer architecture, VLSI design, image processing, video compression, and computer vision.
 Architecture interns study hardware and software trade-offs present in the latest version of our chips and explore uses of both to solve real-world problems. Interns may develop software models of important behaviors in hardware co-processors such as memory bandwidth and pipeline latency or develop visualization tools to illustrate architecture behavior. Interns produce support tools to enable software to make efficient use of hardware co-processors. A final presentation at the end of the internships describes their findings and allows other team members to use their work for ongoing projects.

We expect that interns will be able to pick up missing skills quickly, deliver their assignments on time, and present their work at the end of the program.

title: Data Science Intern
description:
At QuantCo, applied scientists combine advances in AI with rigorous economic and quantitative thinking to build systems that improve high-stakes decisions. As a Data Science Intern, you will work on a substantive, well-scoped project connected to our ongoing research and production work.

Developing methods for AI-driven hypothesis generation and interpretable feature discovery from patterns learned by black-box embedding models.

Building agents that turn unstructured product data into reliable signals.

title: Data Management Graduate 2027 Summer Intern
description:
Data Management Graduate Internship 
 We’re developing the next generation of Colleagues! 
 Join the data-driven culture at Citizens and learn how we keep customers at the center of everything we do. We are looking for interns to join our 10-week summer internship program and support innovative data & analytics initiatives across the bank. 
 Experience during the program 
 Our program offers interns a unique dual experience – Participants spend half of their time individually partnered with a host team within the data & analytics community to participate in ongoing work. Assignments for data analyst interns may be in areas aligned to data quality monitoring, metadata management, ETL support, data integration, SQL development, cloud-based data tools, and exploratory data analysis- including tasks related to reporting, dashboarding, and ad-hoc investigations. This component of the program provides direct exposure to teams in areas that align to intern education and interests. 
 The other half of the time, interns work on a cross-functional team, collaborating with other Data & Analytics interns, colleagues, and business partners to work on a real-world project. Projects are tailored so interns can experience the full project cycle. title: Internal Audit Internship 2027
description:
2027 Internal Audit Summer Internship 
 We’re developing the next generation of leaders   
 You have a unique opportunity to jumpstart your career through hands-on, impactful projects, comprehensive training and development, and exposure to executive leadership, paving the way for a robust career at Citizens. 
 The Internal Audit Summer Internship Program is a critical program in the Internal Audit Department for cultivating talented, young professionals who aspire to be future leaders. As part of this program, you’ll accelerate the development of analytical, communication, and project management skills and gain foundational audit skills through on-the-job training with an audit team focused on controls over key risks across Citizens.    
 The Internal Audit team is made up of over 100 highly-skilled professionals with the mission of providing the Board, Audit Committee, Shareholders, and Executive Management with an independent and objective view of the effectiveness of the bank’s control environment, risk management practices, and culture.   Internal Audit provides independent assurance on the appropriateness of the design and operational effectiveness of risk management and internal control processes that mitigate the bank ’ s key risks, provides advice to improve the organization’s governance and risk management framework, and assesses the appropriateness, effectiveness, and sustainability of action plans developed by bank management to improve controls.   Internal Audit

title: 2027 Commercial Summer Intern - Global Markets, Boston, MA
description:
Job Title: 2027 Commercial Summer Intern – Global Markets, Boston, MA 
 Location: Boston, MA 
 Duration: 10 weeks 
 Start Date: June 1, 2027 
 Commercial Summer Internship Program 
 The Commercial Summer Internship Program is designed to give interns a look at Citizens Bank’s culture and exposure into one of the many commercial banking business lines through project-based assignments, learning curriculum, networking, volunteer opportunities and formal mentorship. Responsibilities will vary based on the group you’re assigned to and will leverage your unique skills and abilities. At the conclusion of the program, high-performing interns will receive early consideration for full-time opportunities within the line of business in which they completed their summer internship. 
 Summer Analysts within Global Markets will work closely with the Sales team’s junior and senior professionals, provide support across the team, and begin to develop an understanding of Global Markets and the macroeconomic impact of domestic and foreign policies and events. Citizens Global Markets helps clients reduce the impact of interest rate and foreign exchange (FX) rate volatility on financial statements, forecasts, budgets, investments, dividends, inventory, and cash flows. We work with clients and prospects to identify exposures based on expertise and economic insights, design methodologies for quantifying the potential impact of risks on financial performance and determine overall risk. title: Summer Associate Internship (Penetration Testing)
description: The Adversarial Security Practice (ASP) is part of Navy Federal’s Secure Innovation & Resiliency (SIR) organization and is responsible for conducting penetration testing, red team operations, remediation validation, and other adversarial security assessments to identify and help remediate vulnerabilities before they can be exploited. ASP partners with technology, development, and cybersecurity teams to improve security controls, validate defenses, and strengthen the organization’s overall security posture. A Summer Associate on the team will gain hands-on exposure to offensive security operations, security research, penetration testing activities, and strategic cybersecurity initiatives while working alongside experienced security professionals. The associate will also complete a meaningful project that delivers lasting value through research, process improvement, or security capability development.

title: Summer Associate Internship (Product Security Engineer)
description:
The Product Integrity & Testing (PIT) Team is responsible for the independent security assessment of applications, APIs, and agentic AI components prior to production deployment. The team leverages advanced security testing capabilities, including AI-enabled Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), API security testing, and AI red teaming, to identify vulnerabilities, security defects, and potential misuse scenarios before software is released into the production environment.

In addition to security testing, PIT provides oversight and governance of Navy Federal's software supply chain. This responsibility includes helping ensure that the software, services, components, AI models, agents, and supporting development technologies introduced into the enterprise have undergone appropriate security review and testing, reducing risk and strengthening trust in the software that powers Navy Federal's business operations.

title: Cost Engineering Intern
description:
Inside the Role 
Interns will gain knowledge and experience through exciting and real-life learning opportunities. Interns must work in accordance with DTNA’s core values of passion, respect, integrity and discipline. Internship positions can be located at various DTNA locations across the US. We are looking for high performing and motivated individuals in various areas within DTNA organizations. DTNA internships begin each summer in May or June.
Interns in this role may have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position subject to manager evaluations and business availability.
The Cost Engineering department is a global team responsible for calculating costs of purchased parts and tooling for series production and new projects. Through the use of standardized processes, IT-systems and our global Cost Engineering network within Daimler Trucks, we generate transparent bottom up cost calculations that can be utilized a multitude of ways.
In this role, you will calculate bottom-up costs of future and series parts based on technical specifications, engineering design proposal, NX 3D modeling, or part teardowns. Considers materials, manufacturing process, labor, variable and fixed costs according to both global and regional inputs within aggregate specific guidelines. You will also support Cost Engineering with continuous improvement and digitalization projects.
